title: The sea, My solace
author: Runa Srivastava
text:
I sat on the pier that day
In a rather shabby blue dress
I hadn`t changed for days
I felt I didn`t need to
I had nothing to look forward to
I had nothing approaching in the horizon
I felt I had reached a plateau
And gloom has started to settle
Like dense clouds around me
Blocking all hopes and the drive
Till I decided to tete-a-tete with the sea
I really don`t know why I do it
Maybe being a sailors daughter
My confidante became the sea
I watched the waves as they came in
And then slowly left to join the sea
That set a rhythm to my heart
As if it it was filling me with hope
Making the gloom ebb
My legs swung in joyful freedom
I felt alive, I felt repaired
